name: Pythagoras' theorem
subject: Maths
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" role="img">

<polygon points="320,355 440,355 440,475 320,475" fill="#d1fae5" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="3"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.35;1" dur="3s" begin="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></polygon>
<polygon points="320,265 440,355 530,235 410,145" fill="#fce7df" stroke="#e7704f" stroke-width="3"><animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.35;1" dur="3s" begin="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></polygon>
<polygon points="320,265 320,355 440,355" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#253653" stroke-width="3"/>
<path d="M320 337 H338 V355" fill="none" stroke="#253653" stroke-width="2"/>

<text x="275" y="325" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d4ed8">square units</text>
<text x="380" y="410" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#047857">b² = 16</text>
<text x="380" y="433" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle" fill="#047857">square units</text>
<text x="425" y="245" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#b84a30">c² = 25</text>
<text x="425" y="267" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle" fill="#b84a30">square units</text>
<text x="329" y="314" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="15" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start" fill="#253653">3</text>
<text x="376" y="348" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="15" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle" fill="#253653">4</text>
<text x="554" y="370" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start" fill="#b84a30">Hypotenuse c = 5</text>
<path d="M548 365 L425 344" stroke="#b84a30" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><rect x="30" y="526" width="740" height="48" rx="12" fill="#eaf0fa"/><text x="400" y="556" font-family="DejaVu Sans" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#243a5a">a² + b² = c²     ·     9 + 16 = 25</text>
</svg>
